title: Mohan Appeals at Vaisakhi for Land and Shelter

blocks.text: The displaced Mehraj family finally seeks help through sacred assembly rather than wandering alone. At the Vaisakhi festival Mohan and Kala are brought before the Guru, turning a problem of survival into a petition framed within darbar and service.

Mohan (from Mehraj's family) is presented not as a claimant by force but as a servant asking for a future. Kala offered his services to the Guru's community kitchen, and then the family openly asks for a piece of land for his clan's settlement.
The response is prophetic rather than merely administrative. The Guru's blessing suggests that today's landless petitioners may yet become the people from whom others will one day request land.
